subject: general
question: Which of the following CANNOT take a negative value?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Standard Deviation.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Standard Deviation**

__
 
• **It is square root of Variance of observations and square root is always positive.**
 
• It is a** measure of how dispersed the data is in relation to the mean.**

**Variance**

 
• It is a **measure of variability**.
 
• Calculated by taking the **average of squared deviations from the mean.**
 
• The **degree of spread in your data set.**
 
• The **more spread the data, the larger the variance is in relation to the mean.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Skewness

 
• It is a measure of the** asymmetry of a distribution**.
 
• A distribution is **asymmetrical when its left and right side are not mirror images**.
 
• A distribution can have** positive, negative, zero** skewness.

**Mean**

 
• It is the **average of all the observations in data set.**

**Median**

 
• It is the** middle value of the given list of data, when arranged in an order.**
